title: Basecamp apps by thehat
tagline: Unofficial hobby apps for Logos Basecamp. Add the catalogue once, then install and update them from inside Basecamp.

manifesto_ui.title: Manifesto
manifesto_ui.blurb: Read the Logos manifesto and sign it in one click. The app makes a signing key for you, so you need no account, and anyone can check your signature without a server.

onesecret_ui.title: OneSecret
onesecret_ui.blurb: Share a secret that can be read once. You paste it and get a link. Whoever opens the link gets the secret, and your own Basecamp destroys the key on the first read. There is no server.

chess_ui.title: Chess
chess_ui.blurb: Play chess against the Stockfish engine, pass and play on one computer, or play a friend online with chat.

presence_ui.title: Presence pilot
presence_ui.blurb: An experiment: presence beacons that rotate so an observer cannot link them to each other, while your friends still recognise you. Simulated locally or carried over Logos Messaging.
